tasks.subject: Task 1: Schema — PriceSurvey + PriceSurveyResponse models
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add the data model this feature depends on.

**Files:**
- Modify: `prisma/schema.prisma`
- Modify: `prisma/schema.production.prisma`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `PriceSurvey` model exists with a unique `token`, relation to `Product` (onDelete Cascade), and `merchantId`
- [ ] `PriceSurveyResponse` model exists with the four price fields and a relation to `PriceSurvey` (onDelete Cascade)
- [ ] `Product` gains a `priceSurveys PriceSurvey[]` relation
- [ ] Both schema files stay in sync

**Verify:** `npx prisma db push && npx prisma generate` → no errors

```json:metadata
{"files": ["prisma/schema.prisma", "prisma/schema.production.prisma"], "verifyCommand": "npx prisma db push && npx prisma generate", "acceptanceCriteria": ["PriceSurvey model with unique token", "PriceSurveyResponse model with four price fields", "Product.priceSurveys relation added", "both schema files in sync"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Van Westendorp calculation module
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A pure, testable function that computes the four Van Westendorp intersections and a confidence tier from a set of survey responses.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/priceSurvey/vanWestendorp.ts`
- Test: `src/lib/priceSurvey/vanWestendorp.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `calculateVanWestendorp(responses)` returns PMC, PME, OPP, IPP, acceptable range, response count, confidence tier
- [ ] Confidence tiering: none <5, low 5–19, good 20+
- [ ] Empty input returns all-zero result with confidence "none", no throw
- [ ] Single response produces a deterministic, hand-verifiable result (PMC=1000, PME=1500, OPP=1000, IPP=1250 for the test fixture)

**Verify:** `npm test -- src/lib/priceSurvey/vanWestendorp.test.ts` → all pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/lib/priceSurvey/vanWestendorp.ts", "src/lib/priceSurvey/vanWestendorp.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm test -- src/lib/priceSurvey/vanWestendorp.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["empty input returns all-zero none-confidence result", "single-response fixture matches hand-derived PMC/PME/OPP/IPP", "confidence tiers correctly at 5/20 boundaries", "multi-response input does not throw"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Survey creation + listing API (authenticated)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Let a merchant create a survey for a product they own and list its surveys.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/priceSurvey/token.ts` + test
- Create: `src/app/api/products/[id]/surveys/route.ts` + test

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `generateSurveyToken()` returns a 64-char hex string
- [ ] `POST /api/products/[id]/surveys` creates a survey for an owned product, returns {id, token, shareUrl}
- [ ] POST on unowned/nonexistent product → 404
- [ ] `GET /api/products/[id]/surveys` lists surveys with responseCount, most recent first

**Verify:** `npm test -- src/lib/priceSurvey/token.test.ts "src/app/api/products/[id]/surveys/route.test.ts"` → all pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/lib/priceSurvey/token.ts", "src/lib/priceSurvey/token.test.ts", "src/app/api/products/[id]/surveys/route.ts", "src/app/api/products/[id]/surveys/route.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm test -- src/lib/priceSurvey/token.test.ts \"src/app/api/products/[id]/surveys/route.test.ts\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["token is 64-char hex", "POST creates survey and returns shareUrl", "POST 404s on unowned product", "GET lists surveys with responseCount desc by createdAt"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Public survey lookup + respond API
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The public-facing endpoints a customer's browser calls — no login, rate-limited, cookie-guarded.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/app/api/survey/[token]/route.ts` + test
- Create: `src/app/api/survey/[token]/respond/route.ts` + test

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `GET /api/survey/[token]` returns product title/image for valid token, 404 for unknown
- [ ] `POST /api/survey/[token]/respond` rejects non-positive or out-of-order (tooCheap > tooExpensive) prices with 400
- [ ] Repeat submission with the same anti-resubmit cookie → 409, no second row created
- [ ] Rate limited via checkWebhookRateLimit keyed by IP → 429 when exceeded
- [ ] Success creates the response row and sets the anti-resubmit cookie

**Verify:** `npm test -- "src/app/api/survey/[token]"` → all pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/app/api/survey/[token]/route.ts", "src/app/api/survey/[token]/route.test.ts", "src/app/api/survey/[token]/respond/route.ts", "src/app/api/survey/[token]/respond/route.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm test -- \"src/app/api/survey/[token]\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["lookup 404s on unknown token, 200 with product info on valid", "respond 400s on non-positive or out-of-order prices", "respond 409s on repeat cookie", "respond 429s when rate limited", "success sets anti-resubmit cookie"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Public survey page
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The standalone, no-app-chrome page a customer sees when they follow the survey link.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/app/survey/[token]/page.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Renders without AppShell/sidebar — no dashboard chrome visible to a public respondent
- [ ] Shows product title/image, four Van Westendorp price inputs, submit button
- [ ] Success shows a thank-you state instead of the form
- [ ] 409 (already responded) / 429 (rate limited) show a clear distinct message, not a generic error

**Verify:** Manual browser check — create a survey, visit /survey/[token] in an incognito window, submit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/app/survey/[token]/page.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "manual browser check per plan Task 6 Step 2", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no AppShell chrome on public page", "four price inputs render with product info", "409/429 show distinct messages", "success shows thank-you state"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

- Create: `src/components/PriceSurveyCard.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- [ ] Empty state offers "Create survey link"; active state shows copyable link + response count
- [ ] Chart renders once a survey has ≥5 responses, with a visible confidence label
- [ ] Pure SVG chart, no new charting library dependency
- [ ] Full npm test suite passes with no regressions

**Verify:** `npm test` (full suite) then manual browser check per plan Task 7 Step 5
